parked.spanish: y juzgará la congregación entre el hiriente y entre el redentor de la sangre sobre los juicios estos.

findings.issue: וְשָׁפְטוּ is qal sequential perfect 3rd common plural; juzgará is 3rd singular. The subject הָעֵדָה is one feminine singular congregation, so the singular verb is Spanish agreement with that collective and does not change the participant.

parked.spanish: Y librará la congregación al matador de mano del redentor de la sangre, y lo hará volver la congregación a ciudad de su refugio que huyó allá, y habitará en ella hasta muerte del sacerdote el grande, que ungió a él en aceite de la santidad.

findings.issue: וְהִצִּילוּ and וְהֵשִׁיבוּ are hiphil sequential perfect 3rd common plural; librará and hará are 3rd singular. The subject הָעֵדָה is one feminine singular congregation, so the singular verbs are Spanish agreement with that collective and do not change the participant.
נָס is qal perfect 3ms and אֲשֶׁר … שָׁמָּה marks the place. «que huyó» makes the relative antecedent the one who fled, so the slayer is no longer the subject.
The resumptive object אתו marks the priest as the one anointed by a 3ms subject; «que ungió a él» makes the priest the anointer and él another person.

parked.spanish: Todo hiriente alma, sobre boca de testigos matará al matador; y testigo uno no responderá en alma para morir.

findings.issue: לְ on the construct «mouth» is to/for/according-to; «sobre» renders it as upon/over.
